books.title: The Big Sun
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: The sun is big and hot. It shines in the sky.
Ana puts on her hat. She goes out to play.
Ana plays in the sand. The sand is warm and soft.
Ana drinks cold water. It makes her feel good.
At night the sun goes down. Ana says, 'Good night, sun.'

books.title: A Cup of Milk
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Mum pours a cup of milk. The milk is white and cold.
Leo drinks the milk. He likes the taste.
Leo sees a cookie on the plate. He takes one cookie.
Leo eats the cookie. It is sweet and good.
Leo says, 'Thank you, Mum.' Then he goes to play.

books.title: Ben and the Bus
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Ben waits for the bus. The bus is big and yellow.
The bus stops. Ben gets on the bus.
Ben sits by the window. He sees trees and houses.
The bus stops at school. Ben gets off the bus.
Ben runs to his class. He is happy to be at school.

books.title: The Big Egg
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A hen has a big egg. The egg is white and round.
The hen sits on the egg. She sits all day long.
Crack! Crack! The egg moves. The egg opens!
A little chick comes out. The chick says, "Cheep, cheep!"
The hen is happy. She has a new little chick.
